name: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University
summary: Chinese–British joint-venture university in Suzhou with largely English-medium undergraduate study and XJTLU/Liverpool dual degrees.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma with 30 points can be considered for Year Two, subject to degree prerequisites; this is not a Year One floor. Year Two English: IELTS 6.5, each 5.5, or TOEFL 90, each 21. Confirm IB waivers.

programmes.name: BEng (Hons) Intelligent Robotics Engineering with Contemporary Entrepreneurialism
programmes.about: Combines robotics, artificial intelligence, automation and engineering with entrepreneurship and practical work on industry problems.
programmes.overview: Students study robotics alongside computer science, electronics, communications, sensing, machine learning and mechatronics. The degree adds enterprise development, leadership and project management to its technical training. Teaching includes work with physical robot systems and practical projects associated with the School of Robotics and its industry partners in Taicang. It prepares students for robotics, automation and technology innovation, including opportunities to develop their own ventures.

programmes.selectionNote: Academic and English evidence assessed for the chosen entry year; IB 30 permits Year Two consideration, subject to relevant subjects.
programmes.ib: Mathematics and Physics are required; no IB AA/AI, HL/SL or minimum subject grade is specified. Confirm the Year One or Year Two conditions.

programmes.name: BEng (Hons) Industrial Design
programmes.about: A studio-based degree combining human-centred product design, technology, fabrication and sustainable design practice.
programmes.overview: Students investigate how people interact with physical and digital products, moving from user research and visual concepts to prototypes and testing. Studio projects use fabrication facilities, including 3D printing, scanning and laser cutting, to develop and evaluate designs. The curriculum connects technical, cultural, environmental and commercial considerations and offers industry collaboration and internship opportunities. Graduates can pursue work in product design and related design practices or further study.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Economics and Finance
programmes.about: Integrates economic theory, finance, quantitative modelling and applied analysis of businesses, markets and policy.
programmes.overview: Students learn microeconomics, macroeconomics, accounting and financial concepts, then develop quantitative skills through mathematical economics, statistics and econometrics. Further study covers corporate finance, financial instruments and policy and market analysis. The business school describes applied learning resources, including a trading floor and financial-data facilities, alongside industry links. The degree supports progression into financial services, economic analysis, related professional work or postgraduate study.

notes: Published degrees normally take four years from Year One; suitable IB Diploma holders may enter Year Two and complete the remaining three years.
International students must be at least 17 by 1 September 2027; those under 18 need a guardian in China. Chinese-heritage nationality rules also require checking.
Published international tuition is CNY 99,000 a year. Early-bird and scholarship deadlines have separate document and deposit conditions; confirm the applicable offer.
